q: Calculate the resultant force on the cyclist.
Describe what happens to the boat and explain why.
Resultant 2500 − 2000 = 500 N backwards: the boat slows down.
The skydiver opens a parachute and the backward force rises to 700 N. Explain what happens to the motion before and after.
Before: resultant 400 N down, so the skydiver speeds up. After: forces balanced (700 N each), so the skydiver falls at a steady speed (once the parachute has slowed them).
